description: Parts that bind material.glass.chip where a state block is in play: the chip bound only inside `readonly`, with a fallback cell missing; fallback cells a state block rebinds with the wrong token, keyed by the ground, or keyed apart from the background; a part fallback keyed apart from where a state binds the chip; and a reduceTransparency that does not name Reduce Transparency, on a spec whose first chip is bound only in a state. A state that restates the fallback as the part binds it is not reported.
